resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1941 for a two-story cupola cabin. Kemnow's quotation of a 1944 Air Warning Service report says the station was activated August 22, 1942, used existing state facilities, and added a shake cabin. The sources do not say whether these are the same structure, so the story leaves that open.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today or public access, so the access and visit fields are left out. The Baker 6-6 name and the 1944 report come from Kemnow's quotation; the report itself was not read. The record material wood has no source in these pages apart from the shake cabin, so check it before relying on it. Willhite's list keeps Owl Mountain as a 1941 lookout; the AWS-only page was not found in this run. The FFLA list calls the site AWS Owl Mountain, which matches the record's other_names.
